reviews_h2: Straight from the people who called us

reviews.author: Alexandra Casey
reviews.text: Where to start! I had a 75 foot dead pine tree in my backyard. I initially called and spoke with Krystal, their receptionist, who was so sweet. She went above and beyond to try and fit me into their busy schedule. Then Burl came out to take a look at the tree and give me an estimate. He was a kind and honest man. I asked him to look at all of the trees on my property to see if there were others that were dangerous and needed to come down and he was honest and told me no. Owner Paul Toler and his crew came out and did a fantastic job. Got here when they said they would, and stayed until the job was done and cleaned up. All of the crew members were professional and friendly. If you can believe it, they actually left my place better than they found it. Not only did they take down the terrifying tree, but they also cleared off all the pine straw that had been sitting on my roof all season. I have had bad experiences with tree companies in the past, but I am so thankful that I have found American Tree Company.

reviews.author: Taylor Patterson
reviews.text: Leave their mess of mud and trees all over the roads of the neighborhood after continually blocking roads with no other way in or out with their trucks for days. Empty food bags and trash left to blow all over the place. Them and B&B land pro, which appear to be the same family, obviously don’t have much respect for surrounding neighbors of their jobs. Similar reviews posted by others a few years ago tell me this is a common theme for them. Clean up your mess and stop blocking our roads or I’ll file complaints with every office I possibly can.

reviews.author: 1mangoldrush
reviews.text: These guys mean business. Paul showed up with an Army! They walked up, evaluated the monster of tree I have, asked follow on questions, and got to it. The put down padding to protect the grass, removed everything they cut, and even tolerated the nosey neighbors. Price was exceptional but the professionalism is where they shine! The sawdust is even hard to find. Highly recommend American Tree Co. My thanks goes out to everyone.

reviews.author: Greg Mele
reviews.text: What a great experience overall. From Mr. Berl, the estimator who was a pleasure to speak with to Paul, the owner and his Team onsite. They were very reasonably priced and the work was excellent. When they left, it was like I never knew they were there other than the trees and stumps were gone. Cleaned up perfectly. I highly recommend American Tree Service!

reviews.author: Dottie J
reviews.text: This company did a fantastic job! They showed on time with a large crew. They work like a well oiled machine, and two hours later the two trees were gone, and except for the absence of the trees, no one could tell the company had been there. I will definitely use them for the nine other trees I need removed.

reviews.author: Terence Horncastle
reviews.text: The lady on the phone was very nice. The price was a little less than my other quote. Both the job appraiser and the work crew turned up a little ahead of time. They were pleasant, careful, professional and respected my property. The cleared up after themselves and the area was tidier after they left than it was before. Would definitely use them again.

reviews.author: Suzanne Suva
reviews.text: I had a massive tree that was taking over my yard. These guys were professional and did a fabulous job on clean up! Next time I need a tree removed, I will definitely be calling them,

reviews.author: Wendi Brant
reviews.text: After having my two large pecan trees butchered by another tree trimming service, I was hesitant to have my Crepe Myrtle trees pruned. But my lawn service guy told me to call American Tree and I’m so happy I did! They came out and took so much time with me while explained what I wanted and my concerns. They even left a nest on one of the branches because I was worried about our local birds. The trees had been neglected for a few years and were a mess of tangled and dead limbs but now they look healthy. And they don’t look like they’ve been pruned half to death. I highly highly highly recommend these guys! They listen and care and the front office is also the sweetest.

reviews.author: bryan Fisher
reviews.text: A FANTASTIC JOB!!!! This company came in on time well organized extremely professional. We had four big pine trees and stumps removed three of them along a fence line. They came in took all the trees raked up blew off the driveway left the property in better shape and neater when they finished.. HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!!! Great job and Thank you! George Fisher

reviews.author: Rick Norton
reviews.text: Paul and his crew arrived on time. Took extraordinary measures to protect the grass. Their clean up was amazing including blowing sawdust off the roof. Left little evidence when they were finished. We will use their services again.

reviews.author: Wayne Bedenbaugh (Wayneo)
reviews.text: Needed three large problematic trees removed quickly. They called me back that evening and said they had a cancellation and could the come the next morning. I paid a premium due to the fact that they could not get a machine into my back yard since it was fenced in (premium was expected and not at all excessive). Any how, first thing the next morning a small army of workers showed up took down three trees lugged the wood manually through my yard, across the lawn and into their trucks. The job was fantastic. Not a bit of damage to any of my landscaping and, I swear the lawn looks better than the day before. Can't recommend this outfit enough.

reviews.author: Josh Guin
reviews.text: They operate with a sense of urgency and professionalism. The best part of the job was watching the team operate like a well oiled machine. I was so impressed that I scheduled a second job with them. I would highly recommend!

reviews.author: Marla Massey
reviews.text: This company was great! Very professional from the time I placed the first call to get a quote to the completed job. The guys made sure everything was done as I wanted and then cleaned up completely ! I was 100% satisfied with their work!

reviews.author: Candice Payne
reviews.text: Our Management Service Company used them for tree removal of about 5 or more trees in the Association we live in and they did a fantastic job and were courteous to us homeowners and made the area neat afterwards! Very impressed!

reviews.author: John Baldwin
reviews.text: America Tree Co is an excellent solution for any tree problems you encounter. American Tree services are very fairly priced and all of the employees are very knowledgeable and professional. John Baldwin

reviews.author: SuperBullies1
reviews.text: Perfect job removing tree's and grinding stumps. They bend over backwards to make sure you're perfectly satisfied and then clean-up after themselves. Owner is on site working and over-seeing.

reviews.author: bobby terry
reviews.text: I have had the pleasure of them doing some tree and stump removal for me a few times. They are reasonable, reliable, and friendly. They work hard and do great work. Really happy with the service.

reviews.author: Alicia Luna
reviews.text: These guys did a great job and went above and beyond our expectations. We will recommend them to others and definitely use them again in the future. Thank you guys for a job well done.

reviews.author: Fern Martin
reviews.text: They removed trees for me. Everyone was working together to accomplish the same goals. Very organized!! Were very aware of footprint they were leaving. Will use again, definitely.

reviews.author: Barbara Berger
reviews.text: Skilled professionals, well oranized and after the removal of our 80'+ magnolia, they left things neater than how they found it. Well-run company - I highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Kyle Lafleche
reviews.text: Blocked entrance to Fairfield harbour driver knew he had no room but decided to block driveway anyway saw 10 cars of residents waiting to enter but didn’t care.

reviews.author: David Spencer
reviews.text: They left no evidence that they were even there, except the trees were gone. Professional. Honest. Excellent work.
